annotations.exact_quote: This paper explores the problem of multi-view spectral clustering (MVSC) based on tensor low-rank modeling.
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要以多视图谱聚类为研究任务，并显式建模视图内与视图间关系，符合多视图学习设定。

annotations.exact_quote: we explicitly impose a symmetric low-rank constraint and a structured sparse low-rank constraint on the frontal and horizontal slices of the tensor
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要对张量切片显式施加低秩约束，并用结构化张量低秩范数建模，属于低秩建模。
